verdict.rationale: Supermemory has an API reference section that points to the official TypeScript and Python clients (docs-26). The docs include copy-pasteable SDK code snippets for add and search (docs-24, docs-27). Nothing shows the reference is interactive, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no visible spec to drive a playground. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground API explorer, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
